body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Pioneer presented its mini home theater system ''HTS-570''. It features powerful 5.1 surround sound, ‘MCACC room calibration’ functionality, dual center speaker, front stage surround, and sound retriever.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Nikki Hwang, Daniel Seo >
